name: RDP Connection
description: Structure documentation for an RDP connection profile, representing the configuration parameters used to establish a Remote Desktop Protocol session.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Friendly name for this connection profile.

fields.name: host
fields.description: Hostname or IP address of the RDP server to connect to.

fields.name: port
fields.description: Network port for the RDP service. Standard port is 3389.

fields.name: username
fields.description: Username used to authenticate with the RDP host.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Active Directory domain or workgroup for the user account.

fields.name: screenWidth
fields.description: Desktop width in pixels for the remote session (minimum 200).

fields.name: screenHeight
fields.description: Desktop height in pixels for the remote session (minimum 200).

fields.name: colorDepth
fields.description: Session color depth in bits per pixel.

fields.name: fullScreen
fields.description: Whether to launch the session in full screen mode.

fields.name: audioMode
fields.description: Where to play remote audio: on the local client, on the remote host, or disabled.

fields.name: redirectClipboard
fields.description: Whether to share the local clipboard with the remote session.

fields.name: redirectPrinters
fields.description: Whether to redirect local printers to the remote session.

fields.name: redirectDrives
fields.description: Whether to redirect local drives to the remote session.

fields.name: useGateway
fields.description: Whether to connect through an RD Gateway server.

fields.name: gatewayHostname
fields.description: Hostname of the RD Gateway when useGateway is true.

fields.name: networkLevelAuthentication
fields.description: Whether to require Network Level Authentication (NLA) before the session is established.
